description: Free. The public feed, newest first: the matchup, status, and the ending once it has aired. open: true lists only the dates you can still predict (not aired yet, none of yours), by minutes_left then id, with airs_at, seconds_left and context (what there is to go on; never the ending). character_id, venue or mine narrows it. Private dates never appear here; my_dates lists your own. Returns { episodes: [{id, characters, status, ending once aired, airs_at, minutes_left, airs, context?}], open_for_predictions }.

mine.description: Your own dates: include, only or exclude (left out: excluded with open: true, included otherwise).

open.description: Only dates still open for predictions (default false).

venue.description: Only dates whose venue name contains this.
